guideline: We evaluate the effectiveness of teachers by measuring the correctness of wug guesses made by human participants, computing a partial correctness metric for each guess: (f is correct) + 0.5(a is correct) + 0.5(b is correct).

Participants are told they will receive 0.05 for every 10 seconds of the teaching interaction that their guess is correct, with partial compensation if only f or only a/b is correct. Participants are told they will receive up to an additional 1.00 based on the accuracy of their predictions.
